description: This file defines the MBRelationship class, which acts as an adapter for the UndeployedRelationships class in the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder module. It manages relationships between modules, providing methods to add, delete, retrieve, and save relationships, as well as to build relationship representations and maintain synchronization between internal variables and the implementation.

classes.name: MBRelationship
classes.description: An adapter class for managing module relationships within SuiteCRM's ModuleBuilder, allowing for adding, deleting, retrieving, and saving module relationships, with internal synchronization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MBRelationship instance, setting up the implementation object and module details.

methods.name: findRelatableModules
methods.description: Delegates to the implementation to find relatable modules.

methods.name: addFromPost
methods.description: Adds a relationship based on POST data, using the underlying implementation.

methods.name: getRelationshipList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of relationships from the implementation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a specific relationship by name from the implementation.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new relationship, converting from old format if necessary, creating a relationship object, and updating internal variables.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a relationship by name using the implementation.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves all changes to the relationships through the implementation.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds relationship representations via the implementation.

methods.name: addInstallDefs
methods.description: Adds installation definitions for the relationships.

methods.name: updateRelationshipVariable
methods.description: Synchronizes the internal 'relationships' variable with the current implementation's relationship list.
